comment: The magnet point and strength are single menu settings applied to all seven tracks here, where randMod7 gives each track its own switch, knob and CV jack. The magnet point item prints the voltages for both ranges at once: 'Lower (0v/-5v)', 'Middle (5v / 0v)', 'Upper (10v/5v)' (RandMod7Compact.cpp:423-425). Only the seventh output can be polyphonic, and the panel marks it with a P. The seven outputs are configured with empty names, which is why the census shows none.
